svg.title: Koydeayss Armed Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 30-31, PDF 31-32. Combined two-deck outline preserves flat tapered nose, long gently widening body, rectangular side machinery pods with bevelled aft corners and tapered central stern. Lower cargo deck aligns at matching grid scale and fits within the upper central hull. Illustration corroborates broad rear shoulders; turret dome and room boundaries excluded.
